name: Align recurring report metric definitions
why: Compares how recurring reports define the same metric and produces one agreed definition, the core of the metric definition sheet skill.

name: Report definition drift review assistant
why: Finds where a report's metric definition quietly changed, which the quarterly dashboard health check looks for.

name: Define your metrics once and write a weekly update
why: Metric definitions plus a plain weekly update, a close match to the KPI report pack skill.

name: Build a weekly KPI report with a forecast and dashboard
why: A rerunnable KPI report and shareable dashboard, useful once the metric cards are agreed.

name: Input metric picker
why: Picks the input metrics a team controls, which become the lower levels of a KPI tree.

name: Vanity metric fixer
why: Swaps counts that only go up for rates you can act on, the same check as the vanity-target mistake in the knowledge file.

name: Marketing scorecard builder
why: Puts slow and fast marketing measures side by side with what each answers, a ready scorecard for one department.

name: Set up product tracking and build a retention dashboard
why: Plans the events first and the dashboard second, the order this role insists on.

name: New-customer profit dashboard builder
why: A worked example of a small-business dashboard with every formula written out, in Google Sheets.

name: Excel PivotTable refresh planner
why: Checks a PivotTable refresh before sharing, for clients whose reporting still lives in Excel.

name: Business tenet scorecard writer
why: Ties principles to measurable checks, helpful when a client's goals are still vague.
